## Live trackers

**[El Niño summer tracker 2026/27](trackers/el-nino-2026/index.qmd):** rain, heat and dam levels through a very strong El Niño summer, updated every Monday.

**[South Africa's temperature, day by day](trackers/sa-temperature/index.qmd):** every day of the year compared with every year since 1981, updated every Monday.

## Stories

Snapshots with a date on them: one question, a few charts, and what the data can't tell us. [All stories](stories/index.qmd)

## How we work

- **Numbers first.** Short text, clear charts, no opinions on policy.
- **Uncertainty shown.** Estimates come with ranges, and every story says what the data can't tell us.
- **Open.** Every chart links to its data and the code that made it.
